title: ReFrame 效能回歸：正確性門檻與容許退化
titleEn: ReFrame regression: correctness gates and tolerated slowdown
subcategoryTitle: 排程與可重現軟體堆疊
summary: 以合成資料重建「ReFrame 效能回歸：正確性門檻與容許退化」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付測試契約、輸出樣本、門檻推導與正負回歸案例。
summaryEn: Reconstruct ReFrame regression: correctness gates and tolerated slowdown with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver test contracts, sample output, threshold derivation and positive/negative regression cases.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

steps.instructionEn:
Missing output or wrong-column parsing is a sanity failure, not zero or ideal performance; repeats distinguish noise.
Against the nominal Separate sanity and performance result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Reverify this criterion: The latter two fail sanity before any speed approval.

steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Missing output or wrong-column parsing is a sanity failure, not zero or ideal performance; repeats distinguish noise.
